jobs.title: Summer Youth Coach
jobs.pay_text: Stipend: $1,000.00 per week of camp completed | First Star ASU Academy is currently searching for ASU undergraduates to work during its Summer Programs as Summer Youth Coaches. The position is a full time, stipend position where Youth Coaches serve as mentors, teacher assistants, tutors, and assistant to the Coordinator, Sr. in its Summer Programs. Employment begins immediately and ends before or by June 30th. Must be able to commit to every day of assigned camp and mandatory training. Assigned mandatory training courses will be completed online and in-person prior to the start of camp. A one-time stipend of $150.00 will be paid for completing trainings prior to the start of camp.
